### Findings
Across authorized products, Complete-item revenue and item counts by brand are summarized below [q1]:

| brand | complete_revenue | complete_items |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| North | 70.0 | 7 |
| South | 140.0 | 7 |

- **North**: Generated 70.0 in revenue across 7 completed items [q1].
- **South**: Generated 140.0 in revenue across 7 completed items [q1].
- While both brands had an identical completed item volume (7 items each), South generated double the revenue of North. Currency is not specified in the underlying dataset.

### Limitations
- Only items with `status = 'Complete'` were queried; cancelled, returned, or pending items were not evaluated [q1].
- Scope is restricted to authorized products (IDs 1 and 2) via executor-bound scoping; catalog-wide performance outside this scope was not queried.
- Analysis is aggregated at the item level; order-level grouping, distinct customer counts, and transaction frequency were not measured.
- No date or promotional dimensions were included, so time trends and price variation over time remain unmeasured.

### Action items (proposed)
- Propose calculating distinct order and customer counts to evaluate whether purchasing patterns differ by brand.
- Propose analyzing unit sale prices relative to product retail prices to compare observed pricing levels between North and South.
- Propose examining status distributions (e.g., returns or cancellations) to assess completion rates across both brands.
